# About me:

- I am a full time employee at Cornell Biological Field Station (CBFS) on Shackelton point Oneida Lake.

- I study Great Lakes zooplankton, and sample all five Great lakes twice a year with vertical zooplankton tows. The rest of the year I am analyzing the samples, identifying crustacians to species and measuring them.

- Outside of work I am enthusiastic about backpacking, I have hiked the Appalachian Trail northbound from Georgia to Maine in 2019. I also hiked the Vermont Long Trail in 2022. Currently I am working on my North East (NE) 115, hiking all mountains in the NE over 4,000 ft. My progress on that is 63/115.

- I live in North Syracuse with my partner and two cats, a tuxedo domestic short-hair named Gunter, and a Siberian forest cat named Egg.
